data.name: Usage collection
data.Description: Finds the logs and databases that AI coding tools write, parses changed files and keeps one stored request per fingerprint. Main code: `src/ai_usage_cost/store.py:190` and `src/ai_usage_cost/sources/base.py:18`.

data.name: Cost pricing
data.Description: Turns token counts into the cost the same usage would have had at published API list prices, using a rate table with periods, bands, tiers and peak windows. Main code: `src/ai_usage_cost/pricing.py:495` and `src/ai_usage_cost/pricing.py:252`.

data.name: Spend reporting
data.Description: Joins priced requests into totals, buckets, sessions, facets and warning groups and presents them on the command line and over HTTP. Main code: `src/ai_usage_cost/pipeline.py:166`, `src/ai_usage_cost/aggregate.py:675`, `src/ai_usage_cost/cli.py:24` and `src/ai_usage_cost/api.py:198`.

data.name: Privacy and retention
data.Description: Decides whether span text may be shown, cuts and redacts it, and applies project exclusion and trace retention. Main code: `src/ai_usage_cost/privacy.py:86` and `src/ai_usage_cost/privacy.py:52`.

data.name: Person using the tool
data.Description: The owner of the machine who runs the commands and opens the dashboard. The code has no other role and no login: `src/ai_usage_cost/cli.py:24`.

data.name: AI coding tool logs
data.Description: The files and databases that AI coding tools write on the machine. They are read and never changed: `src/ai_usage_cost/sources/base.py:123`.

data.name: Notification target
data.Description: A service reached through an Apprise address the person passes to the alert command: `src/ai_usage_cost/cli.py:344`.

data.name: TokenUsage
data.Description: The token counts of one request, split into uncached input, cache read, two cache write buckets, output and reasoning output. `src/ai_usage_cost/models.py:12`
data.Attributes:
- uncached_input, cache_read, cache_write_5m, cache_write_1h, output, reasoning_output: whole numbers, default 0
- cache_write, input_total, total: derived, never stored

data.name: UsageEvent
data.Description: One request read from a log: who made it, when, with which model and how many tokens, plus project and title context. `src/ai_usage_cost/models.py:49`
data.Attributes:
- source, client, session_id, timestamp: required
- provider, model, request_id, tokens: optional; tokens is None when the log has no counts
- tier: service tier, default standard
- reported_cost: the cost the tool itself logged, kept beside the computed one

data.name: CostBreakdown
data.Description: The computed cost of a request or of a group of requests, split into uncached input, cache read, cache write and output, with the no cache baseline. `src/ai_usage_cost/models.py:75`
data.Attributes:
- uncached_input, cache_read, cache_write, output, no_cache_equivalent: dollars
- estimated: true when any part was priced from a shorter id prefix
- total, cache_savings: derived

data.name: PricedEvent
data.Description: A usage event with its cost breakdown (absent when not priced) and its cost state. `src/ai_usage_cost/models.py:117`
data.Attributes:
- event: the usage event
- cost: breakdown or None
- state: priced, free, unpriced or unavailable

data.name: Bucket
data.Description: A group of priced events under one key such as a client, provider, model, project or day, with summed tokens and cost. `src/ai_usage_cost/models.py:123`
data.Attributes: - key, label, tokens, cost, events, sessions, reported_cost

data.name: RateTable
data.Description: The loaded rates.json: model rows, provider cache rules, gateway prefixes and models known to have no price. `src/ai_usage_cost/pricing.py:252`
data.Attributes:
- as_of, currency, units, notes
- models: rows keyed by a match prefix
- providers: cache and batch rules per provider
- prefixes, unpriced_models

data.name: ModelRate
data.Description: One row of the rate table: prices per million tokens for a model id prefix, with variants, bands, a peak window and dated periods. `src/ai_usage_cost/pricing.py:126`
data.Attributes:
- match, provider, display: required
- input, output, cache_read, cache_write_5m, cache_write_1h: dollars per million tokens
- variants, bands, peak, periods, cache_rules, context_window, status

data.name: Report
data.Description: The answer to one query: totals, buckets by client, provider, model, project and day, session rows, warnings and facets. `src/ai_usage_cost/aggregate.py:462`
data.Attributes:
- totals, by_client, by_provider, by_model, by_project, by_day, series, sessions
- unknown_models, warnings, scan_warnings, warning_groups, facets, model_matches
- rates_as_of, rates_age_days, currency, files_scanned, files_in_slice

data.name: SessionRow
data.Description: One session in a report: its time span, models, summed tokens and cost, worst cost state and rating. `src/ai_usage_cost/aggregate.py:48`
data.Attributes:
- session_id, source, client, provider: identity
- start_time, end_time, request_count, tokens, cost, reported_cost
- cost_state: worst of its requests; outcome, traced, error_count, title

data.name: Config
data.Description: The privacy settings read from config.json in the store folder. `src/ai_usage_cost/privacy.py:52`
data.Attributes:
- metadata_only: default true
- exclude_projects, max_content_bytes
- metadata_retention_days, content_retention_days: default None

data.name: Span
data.Description: One step of a session trace: a turn, a message, a model call, a tool call or an error, with timing, tokens and where its record sits in the log. `src/ai_usage_cost/trace.py:55`
data.Attributes:
- span_id, parent_id, session_id, turn_id, agent_id, kind, status
- started_at, ended_at, duration_ms, tokens, context_capacity, each with a provenance
- source_file, record_offset, record_length, content_path

data.name: Outcome
data.Description: The rating a person gives to a session, with notes and tags, plus signals computed from its spans. `src/ai_usage_cost/trace.py:147`
data.Attributes:
- source, session_id: identity
- outcome: successful, partial, failed, abandoned or unrated
- notes, tags, updated_at, signals

data.name: Usage store
data.Description: A SQLite file in the home folder that holds requests, files, trace events, outcomes, exclusions and GPU samples: `src/ai_usage_cost/pipeline.py:28`.

data.name: Rate table file
data.Description: The shipped rates.json beside the pricing code, replaceable with the rates option: `src/ai_usage_cost/pricing.py:22`.

data.name: Privacy configuration file
data.Description: An optional config.json in the store folder. When it is missing or invalid the defaults apply: `src/ai_usage_cost/privacy.py:12`.

data.name: Request
data.Definition: One call to a model as logged by an AI coding tool, stored as a usage event. `src/ai_usage_cost/models.py:49`

data.name: Session
data.Definition: The requests that share a source and a session id. `src/ai_usage_cost/aggregate.py:582`

data.name: Source
data.Definition: A supported AI coding tool with its log locations and parser. `src/ai_usage_cost/sources/base.py:18`

data.name: Service tier
data.Definition: The speed or discount class a request ran on, standard unless the log says otherwise, such as fast or batch. `src/ai_usage_cost/models.py:59`

data.name: Cache read
data.Definition: Input tokens served from a prompt cache, priced at a lower rate. `src/ai_usage_cost/models.py:14`

data.name: Cache write
data.Definition: Input tokens written to a prompt cache in a five minute or one hour bucket. `src/ai_usage_cost/models.py:15`

data.name: Sidechain
data.Definition: A request made by a subagent rather than the main conversation. `src/ai_usage_cost/models.py:58`

data.name: Fingerprint
data.Definition: The short deterministic key that identifies a stored request, from the request id when there is one. `src/ai_usage_cost/store.py:154`

data.name: Rate table
data.Definition: The rates.json data that prices models, with its as of date. `src/ai_usage_cost/pricing.py:252`

data.name: Price band
data.Definition: A price that applies once a request's total input reaches a minimum size. `src/ai_usage_cost/pricing.py:40`

data.name: Price period
data.Definition: A date range in which a row's prices are replaced by others. `src/ai_usage_cost/pricing.py:68`

data.name: Peak window
data.Definition: A recurring UTC weekday and hour window with its own price. `src/ai_usage_cost/pricing.py:47`

data.name: Estimated price
data.Definition: A price taken from a shorter model id prefix, flagged so a guess is never silent. `src/ai_usage_cost/models.py:84`

data.name: Unpriced model
data.Definition: A model with tokens but no rate row. Its tokens count and its cost is left out. `src/ai_usage_cost/pricing.py:425`

data.name: Cost state
data.Definition: One of priced, free, unpriced or unavailable. `src/ai_usage_cost/models.py:8`

data.name: Provenance
data.Definition: How a value is known: measured, derived, estimated, inferred or unavailable. `src/ai_usage_cost/models.py:9`

data.name: Bucket
data.Definition: A group of requests under one key in a report. `src/ai_usage_cost/models.py:123`

data.name: Outcome
data.Definition: The rating a person gives a session. `src/ai_usage_cost/trace.py:26`

data.name: Span
data.Definition: One step of a session trace. `src/ai_usage_cost/trace.py:55`

data.name: Metadata only
data.Definition: The privacy mode, on by default, in which no span text is released. `src/ai_usage_cost/privacy.py:53`

data.name: Redaction
data.Definition: Replacing secrets in released text with a marker that names the kind. `src/ai_usage_cost/privacy.py:78`

data.name: Parser version
data.Definition: A number that, when raised, makes every file be parsed again. `src/ai_usage_cost/store.py:89`

data.name: Amplification
data.Definition: Total input tokens divided by output tokens over the model calls of a session. `src/ai_usage_cost/trace.py:208`

data.name: Missing token counts mean unavailable
data.Statement: A request whose log carries no token counts has the cost state unavailable. It is never priced as zero and never called free. `src/ai_usage_cost/pricing.py:420`

data.name: A free provider costs zero
data.Statement: A request from a provider marked free gets the state free and a zero cost breakdown, provided its tokens are known. `src/ai_usage_cost/pricing.py:434`

data.name: A model without a rate row is unpriced
data.Statement: A request whose model matches no rate row has the state unpriced. Its tokens are counted and its cost is excluded from totals. `src/ai_usage_cost/pricing.py:425`

data.name: A prefix match is an estimate
data.Statement: When a model id matches a row only through a shorter prefix and a remainder that is not a known suffix, the price is flagged estimated and the pipeline raises a warning. `src/ai_usage_cost/pricing.py:313`

data.name: Only listed suffixes count as the same model
data.Statement: A remainder after a row's match key counts as the same model only when it is a dated snapshot, a context window tag, a version or latest. `src/ai_usage_cost/pricing.py:221`

data.name: The longest matching row wins
data.Statement: When several rows match a model id, the row with the longest match key is used. `src/ai_usage_cost/pricing.py:302`

data.name: A known unpriced model beats a guess
data.Statement: An unpriced entry at least as specific as the matching row stops a prefix estimate, so a variant of a priced model is not guessed from its parent. `src/ai_usage_cost/pricing.py:314`

refs.quote: An unpriced entry at least as specific as the row

data.name: Duplicate rate keys are rejected
data.Statement: A rate table with two rows that share a match key fails to load. `src/ai_usage_cost/pricing.py:276`

data.name: A row must name a defined provider
data.Statement: When a rate table defines provider blocks, every row must name one of them, so no row is priced silently with default cache rules. `src/ai_usage_cost/pricing.py:282`

data.name: Price periods must not overlap
data.Statement: A row whose dated periods overlap is rejected at load, because the first matching period would otherwise decide by file order. `src/ai_usage_cost/pricing.py:159`

data.name: Peak windows must not wrap midnight
data.Statement: A peak window uses weekdays 0 to 6 and hour ranges with start below end and end at most 24, so a window across midnight must be split in the file. `src/ai_usage_cost/pricing.py:59`

data.name: The first covering period replaces the row prices
data.Statement: The first period that covers the request's UTC date replaces the row's own price fields, and only the fields the file wrote. `src/ai_usage_cost/pricing.py:449`

refs.quote: The row's price fields after the first period covering

data.name: The largest band at or under the request size applies
data.Statement: Bands are sorted by minimum input and the last band whose minimum is at or under the request's total input prices the whole request. `src/ai_usage_cost/pricing.py:511`

refs.quote: sorted ascending: the last band at or under the request size wins

data.name: An unpriced tier is billed standard and flagged
data.Statement: A service tier other than standard and batch that the row has no price for is billed at the standard price and flagged tier unpriced, which raises a warning. `src/ai_usage_cost/pricing.py:526`

data.name: Cache prices fall back in a fixed order
data.Statement: A cache price is the price set's own figure, else the row's published cache to input ratio times the set's input price, else the provider multiplier times it. `src/ai_usage_cost/pricing.py:486`

data.name: A request is stored once per fingerprint
data.Statement: A later record with the same fingerprint replaces an earlier one only when it carries more output, because streamed records grow and the last one holds the billed count. `src/ai_usage_cost/store.py:359`

refs.quote: the last (equivalently, largest) record carries the final, billed count

data.name: Records that disagree on input tokens keep the first
data.Statement: When two records for one request disagree on input tokens, the first is kept and a warning is added. `src/ai_usage_cost/store.py:352`

refs.quote: disagree on input tokens -- keeping the first

data.name: An unchanged file is not parsed again
data.Statement: A file whose modification time, size and parser version match the stored values is skipped. `src/ai_usage_cost/store.py:229`

data.name: A grown file resumes only when its earlier bytes are unchanged
data.Statement: A file is read from its old end only when its source has a resume hook, it only grew, the previous scan reached its old end and a hash of the bytes before that point still matches. `src/ai_usage_cost/store.py:250`

data.name: A forgotten session is not stored again
data.Statement: After a person forgets a session its spans and rating are deleted and an exclusion row keeps its spans out of later scans. Its requests stay. `src/ai_usage_cost/store.py:273`

data.name: An excluded project drops its spans
data.Statement: A span whose project equals an excluded entry, or whose working directory starts with it, is not stored. `src/ai_usage_cost/store.py:314`

data.name: Span text is refused in metadata only mode
data.Statement: While metadata only is on, or when a span has no content path, reading its text raises content unavailable and the API answers 404. `src/ai_usage_cost/privacy.py:87`

refs.quote: if config.metadata_only or span.content_path is None:

data.name: Released text is cut and then redacted
data.Statement: Text that is released is truncated to the configured byte limit and then has secrets replaced by a marker that names the kind. `src/ai_usage_cost/privacy.py:97`

data.name: A bad configuration file gives the defaults
data.Statement: A missing, unreadable or invalid config.json is replaced by the defaults, which keep metadata only on. `src/ai_usage_cost/privacy.py:63`

data.name: The local calendar day decides the day of an event
data.Statement: An event belongs to the machine's local calendar day, a timestamp without an offset is read as UTC, and both bucketing and date filters use the same function. `src/ai_usage_cost/models.py:146`

data.name: A session shows its worst cost state
data.Statement: The cost state of a session is the worst of its requests, ranked priced, free, unpriced, unavailable. `src/ai_usage_cost/aggregate.py:640`

data.name: A session title prefers the tool, then the latest
data.Statement: The title of a session comes from the highest ranked title source among its events, a tool title first and a folder fallback last, and among equals the latest wins. `src/ai_usage_cost/aggregate.py:21`

refs.quote: Lower rank wins when picking a session's display title

data.name: A reported cost that differs is flagged
data.Statement: A session whose tool reported cost and computed cost differ by more than five percent of the reported figure or one cent gets a warning. Free models are never compared. `src/ai_usage_cost/pipeline.py:133`

data.name: Old rates raise a warning
data.Statement: When the rate table's as of date is more than 30 days old a warning asks for the table to be checked again. `src/ai_usage_cost/pipeline.py:235`

refs.quote: if age is not None and age > STALE_INFO_DAYS:

data.name: Content retention is inert
data.Statement: Setting content retention days only adds a warning, because no content is stored. `src/ai_usage_cost/pipeline.py:242`

data.name: An alert needs exactly one threshold
data.Statement: The alert command needs a window length of at least one day and exactly one of a window total threshold or a rise threshold. `src/ai_usage_cost/cli.py:323`

data.name: An unknown session answers 404
data.Statement: A session route for a source and session id that the store does not hold, or that was forgotten, answers 404. `src/ai_usage_cost/api.py:236`

data.name: Source databases are opened read only
data.Statement: A source database is opened with a read only URI, so the tool never changes another tool's data. `src/ai_usage_cost/sources/base.py:123`

data.name: Request cost state
data.States:
- priced
- free
- unpriced
- unavailable

Each request ends in exactly one state. The estimated flag is a mark on priced, not a state. `src/ai_usage_cost/models.py:8`
data.Transitions:
| From | To | Trigger | Code |
|---|---|---|---|
| loaded | unavailable | the request has no token counts | `src/ai_usage_cost/pricing.py:421` |
| loaded | free | the provider rules say free | `src/ai_usage_cost/pricing.py:422` |
| loaded | unpriced | no rate row matches the model | `src/ai_usage_cost/pricing.py:425` |
| loaded | priced | a rate row matches | `src/ai_usage_cost/pricing.py:426` |

Transitions out of a state are not found: the state is recomputed on every analysis and never changes in place.

data.name: Unpriced model warning
data.Description: Raised once per model that has tokens and no rate. `src/ai_usage_cost/pipeline.py:215`

data.name: Estimated price warning
data.Description: Raised once per model priced from a shorter prefix, naming the parent rate and the token volume. `src/ai_usage_cost/pipeline.py:225`

refs.quote: has no rates.json row of its own

data.name: Tier unpriced warning
data.Description: Raised when requests ran on a tier the row has no price for and were billed at the standard rate. `src/ai_usage_cost/pipeline.py:231`

refs.quote: billed at the standard rate instead

data.name: Reported cost divergence warning
data.Description: Raised for a session whose tool reported cost and computed cost disagree. `src/ai_usage_cost/pipeline.py:135`

data.name: Stale rates warning
data.Description: Raised when the rate table is older than the threshold. `src/ai_usage_cost/pipeline.py:237`

data.name: Session rated
data.Description: Recorded when a person stores an outcome for a session. `src/ai_usage_cost/store.py:568`

data.name: Session forgotten
data.Description: Recorded when a person forgets a session: its spans and rating go and an exclusion is stored. `src/ai_usage_cost/store.py:595`

data.name: Spend alert sent
data.Description: Raised when the window's spend or rise crosses the threshold and the notification is delivered. `src/ai_usage_cost/cli.py:349`

data.name: Conflicting records warning
data.Description: Raised when two records for one request disagree on input tokens. `src/ai_usage_cost/store.py:352`

data.name: Incremental ingest
data.target: An unchanged file is skipped and a grown file is read from its old end when its source allows
data.Statement: Ingest avoids reparsing work: it skips unchanged files `src/ai_usage_cost/store.py:229` and hashes a fixed window of `src/ai_usage_cost/store.py:19` bytes to check a resumed file.

data.name: Rate lookup is cached
data.target: One prefix scan per distinct model id
data.Statement: Rate lookups are cached by the raw model id because a session calls them tens of thousands of times: `src/ai_usage_cost/pricing.py:267`.

data.name: Released text size limit
data.target: At most 65,536 bytes of span text per request by default
data.Statement: Span text is cut to a byte limit before it is returned: `src/ai_usage_cost/privacy.py:11`.

data.name: Store uses write ahead logging
data.target: Journal mode WAL and migrations by user version
data.Statement: The store opens in WAL mode and applies pending migrations in order: `src/ai_usage_cost/store.py:144` and `src/ai_usage_cost/store.py:146`.

data.name: GPU sampler command timeouts
data.target: 10 seconds for nvidia-smi and rocm-smi, 30 seconds for PowerShell counters, 0.5 seconds for Ollama
data.Statement: Each external sampler call has a timeout: `src/ai_usage_cost/collect.py:214`, `src/ai_usage_cost/collect.py:183` and `src/ai_usage_cost/collect.py:197`.

data.name: Server binds to loopback by default
data.Statement: The serve and sql commands listen on the loopback address unless told otherwise: `src/ai_usage_cost/cli.py:110`.

data.name: HTTP routes have no authentication
data.impact: Anyone who can reach the port can read costs and, with the content route, span text if metadata only is off, and can forget sessions
data.likelihood: low while the host stays on loopback
data.Mitigation: The default host is the loopback address `src/ai_usage_cost/cli.py:110` and metadata only is on by default `src/ai_usage_cost/privacy.py:53`.

data.name: Daily series uses the UTC date
data.impact: The by day buckets and the series can place the same event on different days near midnight
data.Risk: Buckets by day use the local day `src/ai_usage_cost/aggregate.py:704` while the series uses `src/ai_usage_cost/aggregate.py:544`.
data.Mitigation: Not found in the code. See the open question on the series day.

data.name: Secret patterns are a fixed list
data.impact: A secret in a form the patterns do not match is returned in released text
data.likelihood: low, and only when metadata only is off
data.Mitigation: Content is off by default `src/ai_usage_cost/privacy.py:53` and text is cut to a byte limit `src/ai_usage_cost/privacy.py:11`.

data.name: A privacy typo silently resets the settings
data.impact: A person who mistypes config.json believes a project is excluded but the defaults apply
data.Risk: An invalid file is replaced by defaults without a message `src/ai_usage_cost/privacy.py:67`.

data.name: Content retention is accepted but does nothing
data.impact: A person may expect text to expire
data.Risk: The setting is read but no content is stored `src/ai_usage_cost/pipeline.py:242`.
data.Mitigation: The pipeline adds a warning when it is set.

data.name: Prices drift from the vendors
data.impact: Cost figures can be wrong without any warning until the table is 30 days old
data.Risk: The table carries an as of date and warns only after a fixed age `src/ai_usage_cost/aggregate.py:179`.
data.Mitigation: Estimated, unpriced and tier gaps are warned about each scan.

data.name: Should the series use the local day
data.Question: The series groups by the UTC date of an event `src/ai_usage_cost/aggregate.py:544` while every other day view uses the local day `src/ai_usage_cost/models.py:146`. Is that intended?

data.name: Who may use the HTTP interface
data.Question: The code has no caller check `src/ai_usage_cost/api.py:198`. Is loopback binding the intended only control, and is a non loopback host a supported setup?

data.name: Will content capture be built
data.Question: Metadata only and content retention exist `src/ai_usage_cost/privacy.py:57` but the pipeline says no content is persisted `src/ai_usage_cost/pipeline.py:242`. Is persisted content planned?

data.name: Why 30 days for stale rates
data.Question: The stale rate threshold is a constant `src/ai_usage_cost/aggregate.py:179`. What is the reason for the value?

data.name: See what my AI usage would cost
rules: An unchanged file is not parsed again
A model without a rate row is unpriced
The local calendar day decides the day of an event
data.Description: The person runs one command and sees what the usage of all their AI coding tools would have cost at list prices, by model, client, provider, project or day.
data.Preconditions: At least one supported tool has written logs on the machine, or the person points to them with a root option.
data.Postconditions: A report is printed or returned as JSON. The store holds the parsed requests for the next run.
Main flow: The person runs the scan command, which accepts since, until, source, by, json, root, db, rates and rebuild options. `src/ai_usage_cost/cli.py:72`
The command analyses the logs. `src/ai_usage_cost/cli.py:87`
The analysis loads the privacy settings and opens the store. `src/ai_usage_cost/pipeline.py:175`
Changed files are ingested into the store. `src/ai_usage_cost/pipeline.py:178`
Stored requests are loaded and each is priced against the rate table. `src/ai_usage_cost/pipeline.py:198`
The report is filtered by the dates and sources. `src/ai_usage_cost/cli.py:88`
With the json option the report is printed as JSON. `src/ai_usage_cost/cli.py:96`
Otherwise the terminal tables are printed. `src/ai_usage_cost/cli.py:105`
Alternative flows: When the report has no requests the command prints that no usage was found and exits with code 1. `src/ai_usage_cost/cli.py:104`
A model with no rate is listed as unpriced and left out of the total. `src/ai_usage_cost/render/terminal.py:34`
Acceptance criteria: Since and until include their boundary days. `tests/test_pipeline.py:71`
Every breakdown sums to the grand total. `tests/test_pipeline.py:203`
Unavailable and unpriced requests count but do not add cost. `tests/test_pipeline.py:486`
Scanning twice changes nothing. `tests/test_store.py:158`

data.name: Explore spend in the dashboard
data.Description: The person opens a local web dashboard to filter and compare cost by client, model, project and session.
data.Preconditions: The dashboard bundle is built, otherwise the root page says how to build it.
data.Postconditions: The browser shows the report; the interface answers the same filters as the command line.
Main flow: The person runs the serve command, which scans the logs first. `src/ai_usage_cost/cli.py:109`
The command builds the application from the analysis. `src/ai_usage_cost/cli.py:133`
The browser asks for the meta data and the report. `src/ai_usage_cost/api.py:255`
The report route passes its filters to the same function the command line uses. `src/ai_usage_cost/api.py:304`
A refresh route analyses again and clears the span cache. `src/ai_usage_cost/api.py:390`
Alternative flows: Without the built bundle the root page returns a message to build it. `src/ai_usage_cost/api.py:401`
Acceptance criteria: The report has the expected shape. `tests/test_api.py:133`
Each filter narrows the report. `tests/test_api.py:233`
A filter that matches nothing returns an empty report. `tests/test_api.py:284`
Refresh invalidates the span cache. `tests/test_api.py:392`

data.name: Export a report as a file
data.Description: The person saves a report as JSON for other tools or as a PNG chart to share.
data.Preconditions: Logs or a store exist for the period.
data.Postconditions: A file with the chosen extension is written.
